title: MIS / Nexis Project
shortDescription: The MIS Inventory Management System streamlines IT asset tracking and management through detailed logs, automated tagging, and integration with Next HRM via LDAP.
longDescription: The MIS Inventory Management System streamlines IT asset tracking and management through detailed logs, automated tagging, and integration with Next HRM via LDAP. It distinguishes between stock and inventory, offering real-time insights and role-based access for efficient hardware lifecycle management. This system simplifies inventory audits, allocations, and repair tracking.
problem: IT assets need a clear history, from allocation to repair.
solution: A role-based inventory platform with automated tagging, detailed logs, and LDAP integration with Next HRM.
outcome: A connected view of stock, inventory, allocations, and the hardware lifecycle.
features: Visual, real-time dashboard displaying key metrics
Local network scanning to collect hardware and software details
Role-based access control with user authentication
Comprehensive logging of system actions, asset changes, and user activities
Real-time tracking of IT assets with detailed specifications
Customizable and pre-built reports on asset usage, audits, and inventory with CSV, PDF, and Excel export
responsibilities: Led frontend Angular development as team lead

title: GetWorker
shortDescription: GetWorker is a website that is similar to freelancer.com in which one user can post a task and others can apply for this task and the tasker can hire one or more bidders to complete the posted task. This is API based project, the API was built in Laravel 6 and, the application was built in Angular 8 and also made a hybrid app in IONIC (using Angular).
longDescription: GetWorker is a website similar to freelancer.com, where one user can post a task, others can apply for it, and the tasker can hire one or more bidders to complete the posted task. It is an API-based project: the API was built in Laravel 6, the application in Angular 8, and a hybrid app in Ionic (using Angular).
responsibilities: Developed the project from start to end, including the backend API and the Angular frontend
